pl-l4prol-d1e112.summary: States that, having treated what pertains to the doctrine of things, things to be enjoyed, things to be used, and those that enjoy and use, Lombard now turns to the doctrine of signs.
claims: The treatment of things is complete; the treatment of signs begins.

pl-l4prol.summary: Marks the transition to Book 4: having treated the doctrine of things, those to be enjoyed, those to be used, and those that enjoy and use, Lombard turns to the doctrine of signs, carrying out the plan announced at the start of the work.
claims: Book 4 turns from the doctrine of things to the doctrine of signs.
